# Overloading the Payment Method of eCommerce

#### Course: Learn Java OOP

## Overloading the Payment Method of eCommerce

In this example, we will implement the payment method for an eCommerce business.

#### Thought Process

We know that every eCommerce business has different payment methods like credit card payment, PayPal payment, and many more.

All payment methods require different information. For example,

To pay through a credit card, we will need a card number, CVV, and expiry date. Similarly, to pay through Paypal, we just need the id.

Let's implement this same logic and overload the payment method with different numbers of parameters.

#### Source Code

```java
1class Payment {
2    
3    // pay through credit card
4    void makePayment(String cardNumber, String cvv, String expiryDate) {
5        System.out.println("Payment Through Credit Card is Successful");
6    }
7    
8    // pay through Paypal
9    void makePayment(String id) {
10        System.out.println("Payment Through PayPal is Successful");
11    }
12}
13
14class Main {
15    public static void main(String[] args) {
16        
17        Payment pay = new Payment();
18        
19        // make payment through credit card
20        pay.makePayment("5415 3252 3523 6315", "131", "12/025");
21        
22        // make payment through PayPal
23        pay.makePayment("97629639067");
24    }
25}
```

Output

```text
Payment Through Credit Card is Successful
Payment Through PayPal is Successful
```
